# Sample Time to Isolation

Draws n samples from the active detection distribution (contact tracing)
for the specified TTIQ scenario or custom configuration.

## Usage

``` r
iso.time.samp(n.ind, the.scenario = "optimal", scenario_config = NULL)
```

## Arguments

- n.ind:

  Integer. Number of samples to draw.

- the.scenario:

  Character. Built-in scenario name: "optimal", "partial", or
  "baseline". Ignored if scenario_config is provided.

- scenario_config:

  A scenario_config object created by
  [`create_scenario_config`](create_scenario_config.md). If provided,
  the.scenario is ignored.

## Value

Numeric vector of isolation times in days.

## Details

Time to isolation represents the delay from index case infection to when
close contacts are identified and isolated via contact tracing (active
detection).

## Examples

# Using built-in scenario
iso.time.samp(100, the.scenario = "optimal")
